title: S4-EXPORT-08 — Shader code travels with its context.
goal: Shader export offers Godot and Unity targets, states that it is shader code only and that textures must be supplied separately, and is ready to export without changing the drawing.

steps.text: Unity remains unverified in its engine.
Shader code only; supply a normalized index texture and palette LUT yourself.

steps.why: The export is ready; this plan does not start the browser download (the file itself is checked outside the App run).

cliOnly: reading the shader text for the target language and palette references (not covered by a replay; engine execution is never claimed)
